purpose: Clarifies the boundary between requirements (What) and design (How) documents and supports deciding where content belongs, with severity catalog, gray-zone allowances, and traceability rules.
summary: Basic principles contrasting requirements and design documents, and relation to ADRs
Decision criteria: already-decided first, then whether the user manual would cover it
Category guides for quantitative goals and feature rationale/value
Severity catalog for What/How boundary violations
Gray-zone allowances for data model types, diagrams, and quantitative targets
Lightweight traceability rules for design review
Approval record via ADR for features not in requirements
tasks: Deciding whether content goes in requirements or design
title: 要件定義書と設計書の境界ガイド
